title: biomes.lakes/1
description: data/biomes/lakes.json: planet generation 2's lakes (docs/world/planet-gen2.md, window 5; WorldLakes). Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-checks (refuse names climate.json's fine biomes; maxSpan at least minWidth) are WorldLakes' own load and lakes_check.

minDepth.description: A valley holds a lake only if its water is at least this deep, in units.

minWidth.description: ... and at least this many columns wide.

minFloor.description: ... and its floor above this height (the sea is not a lake).

maxLevel.description: ... and its level under this height.

margin.description: No town or city within this many columns of the water.

maxSpan.description: How far, in columns, the climb to a crest and the water's reach go (at least minWidth, checked on load).

refuse.description: Fine biomes (climate.json's names) with no lake in them.
